source.notes: Community-mapped suburb polygon, not a surveyed legal boundary. Footprints/names may be incomplete; returned ways can extend past the crop.

notes: Road centrelines and named footprints come from OSM; road widths are enlarged for gameplay.
Building coverage is incomplete. Unmapped courts are not assigned guessed names.
NPCs, entrances, vehicle spawn, dialogue and story are fictional, positioned in clear space near mapped locations.
